description.zh-TW: 一邊讀一本書一邊建伴讀 wiki：一章一則來源、角色頁、主題頁、情節時間線；不劇透，只用讀到的章節寫。
description.en: Build a companion wiki while reading: one source per chapter, character and theme pages, a timeline; spoiler-free.

prompt.zh-TW: 先呼叫 get_instructions 讀編纂規則（含讀書規則）。我會貼一章的摘錄與感想給你：請建立 raw/sources/chNN-章名.md（front-matter 含 book、chapter、pages），再更新或建立相關的角色頁與主題頁、在 wiki/plot.md 追加這一章的事件，最後更新索引與 log.md。只用讀到的內容，不要劇透。
prompt.en: Call get_instructions first (it includes the reading rules). I will paste one chapter's excerpts and reactions: create raw/sources/chNN-title.md (front-matter book / chapter / pages), update or create the related character and theme pages, append the chapter's events to wiki/plot.md, then update the indexes and log.md. Use only what has been read; no spoilers.
